6.385 rsBandIgnoredProperties
Applies to RDL 2011/01
rsBandIgnoredProperties is a non-critical error that will occur when Tablix.BandLayoutOptions is
specified and at least one of the following elements are present:
Tablix.GroupsBeforeRowHeaders

Tablix.RepeatColumnHeaders

Tablix.RepeatRowHeaders

Tablix.FixedColumnHeaders

Tablix.FixedRowHeaders

TablixMember.CustomProperties

TablixMember.FixedData

TablixMember.HideIfNoRows

TablixMember.KeepWithGroup

TablixMember.RepeatOnNewPage

